title: coprosmanthus oldhamii var. daibuensis
intro: Coprosmanthus oldhamii var. daibuensis, commonly known as the Daibu coprosma, is a plant species that belongs to the family Myrsinaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Daibu coprosma include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its use in treating conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Coprosmanthus oldhamii var. daibuensis include iridoids, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
